P1_captier_stock.question: cap-tier-conditional STOCK selection (K200=MEGA / KQ150=MID) — does moving DOWN to the stock x cap-tier layer (where R2 localized the wall) break cap-w?
P1_captier_stock.verdict: FAIL. All 9 variants << baseline 1.277 (best 0.508), paired_vs_mom 9/9 significantly negative. cap-w TRAP re-confirmed: alpha localizes to MID tier (mid_pure 0.430 > mega_pure -0.275, exact reproduction of [[project-captier-alpha-localization-20260706]]) but long-only cross-sectional selection cannot realize it because the cap-w K200 benchmark rewards MEGA that the top-25 basket does not hold. Structuring by cap-tier (a/b/c) DESTROYS the cross-family diversification that carries momentum's residual alpha -> lower, not higher. The wall is NOT at family-allocation NOR at cap-tier-structuring; it is the top-25 long-only cap-w TRANSLATION layer itself, invariant to signal and construction.

P2_capw_native.question: Is R2's EW->cap-w gap a recoverable BASIS ARTIFACT (fixable by re-basing family signal on cap-w-realized active) or genuine cap-w family alpha ABSENCE?
P2_capw_native.verdict: CAPW_FAMILY_ALPHA_ABSENT (basis artifact HYPOTHESIS REJECTED). cap-w양성 family = momentum·value뿐. cap-w-native re-basing PIT판 capw_drop 1.222 < momentum 1.277 AND even the ORACLE (full-sample cap-w-native family foresight) 0.648 < 1.277. Since even perfect cap-w-native family selection cannot beat momentum, the EW->cap-w gap is NOT a recoverable basis artifact at the family layer — it is genuine cap-w family alpha absence. Strengthens R2 oracle (1.248<1.277). Mechanism: dropping cap-w-decoupled families (quality/low_vol/dividend/size) destroys the cross-family diversification carrying momentum's cap-w residual -> ortho harm from a 2nd angle. lag1 gap (0.486) matches PIT-clean momentum baseline gap (0.448) = inherited family-rotation staleness, not same-month leak.

P3_ortho_nonreturn.question: Do orthogonal (Gram-Schmidt residualized) or non-return (crowding/dispersion, momentum-EXCLUDED) base learners escape the shared bull-tilt hull and beat momentum?
P3_ortho_nonreturn.verdict: NO (CONFIRMED, decisive). Orthogonalization made it strictly WORSE (ortho_equal -0.005, ortho_stack -0.044) than R2's collinear stack (0.396). KEY MECHANISM: the R2 collinearity of the 6 EN logic thetas was NOT a defect — it WAS the alpha. The 6 learners are collinear because they share the same profitable family tilt; Gram-Schmidt strips that shared bull-tilt and keeps only near-zero/negative idiosyncratic residual (common component = signal, orthogonal complement = noise — same wall from the reverse direction). Non-return learner (crowding+dispersion) HAS genuine but weak EW signal (ew_uni_t 1.664, beats static +0.696) yet cap-w 0.297 << momentum; softmax stack over near-identical Sharpes dilutes the standalone non-return down to -0.057. REUSABLE RULE: do NOT orthogonalize collinear economic-logic thetas.

meta_judgment_overnight_R1_R2_R3.scope: R1 (6 economic-logic EN thetas + GBM ensemble) + R2 (6 forecasting approaches + family-timing ORACLE) + R3 (3 frontiers: cap-tier stock / cap-w-native / orthogonal+non-return).
meta_judgment_overnight_R1_R2_R3.can_style_forecasting_produce_KR_capw_al: NO within this measurement frame (cap-w K200 benchmark, top-25 EW long-only, 15bps, 163m). Nothing across R1/R2/R3 beat the factor-momentum baseline (cap-w port_t 1.277), and momentum itself is far below the 2.95 HARD gate. best-ever = R2 captier_translate 1.362 (paired_vs_mom 0.751, edge inside noise, oos_ret negative — NOT a real beat). R3 best = P2 capw_drop 1.222 (< 1.277).
wall_location_CONFIRMED_multilayer: L1 family-allocation/timing: NO exploitable cap-w family alpha — R2 oracle (perfect family timing) 1.248 < 1.277 AND R3 P2 oracle (perfect cap-w-native family foresight) 0.648 < 1.277. EW->cap-w gap is genuine alpha absence, NOT a recoverable basis artifact.
L2 stock x cap-tier selection: alpha localizes to MID tier (cap-w trap) but long-only cross-sectional selection cannot realize it (benchmark rewards un-held MEGA). R3 P1 best 0.508 << 1.277.

L3 the actual binding wall = top-25 long-only cap-w TRANSLATION layer. Momentum's ~1.28 residual alpha comes ONLY from cross-family diversification in the top-25 basket — destroyed by concentration (P1 b/c), tier-structuring (P1 a/c), orthogonalization (P3), or family-dropping (P2). It is a byproduct of basket breadth, not of any forecast/timing skill.
meta_judgment_overnight_R1_R2_R3.verdict: SETTLED-NEGATIVE (config-scoped, NOT structural). Style-factor FORECASTING is settled-negative at both the family-allocation and stock x cap-tier layers within the cap-w top-25 long-only frame. This is a config-scoped negative on the forecasting APPROACH, not a structural verdict on KR alpha — the frontier remains open along axes that leave the cap-w return-derived translation layer.
meta_judgment_overnight_R1_R2_R3.consistency_with_prior_knowledge: Exact reproduction of [[project-captier-alpha-localization-20260706]] (MID>MEGA, cap-w trap), [[project-megacap-anchor-construction-discovery]] (cap-w artifact / EW-대비 확인 의무 — allmom ew_uni 1.74 & non-return ew_uni 1.66 both live in EW space but die in cap-w), and [[feedback-qepm-method-frontier-dualization]] (binding = momentum decay itself, not drawdown — -> 비-return).
